articles.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
articles.description: Dozens of people are missing beneath the rubble of a building hit by an Israeli strike last year, where some 10 families had been living.

articles.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
articles.description: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".

articles.title: EU offers Canada chance to become first 'associate member' in wake of Trump's trade war
articles.description: The European Union wants Canada to become the block's first "associate member", as the country's trade war with Donald Trump escalates.

articles.title: Reward offered after British woman is kidnapped in Malawi
articles.description: Police in Malawi have offered a reward after a British woman was kidnapped in the southern African country.

articles.title: Kosovo's former president jailed for 25 years over war crimes
articles.description: Kosovo's former president Hashim Thaci has been jailed for 25 years after being found criminally responsible for war crimes following a trial in The Hague.

articles.title: At least 21 killed and dozens trapped after war-damaged Gaza building collapses
articles.description: At least 21 Palestinians who were sheltering in a bombed-out apartment building in Gaza have been killed after the structure collapsed overnight.

articles.title: Early results in Swedish election show one-seat advantage for left bloc
articles.description: Preliminary results in Sweden's national election are indicating a narrow one-seat advantage for the left-wing opposition over Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson's right-wing coalition.
